caseNameFull: Bauer-Smith Dredging Co., Inc. v. Tully
attorneys: T. G. Schirmeyer for petitioner. Ewell Strong and Geo. A. Weller for respondents.

opinions.text: Motion for leave to'file brief of National Association of River and Harbor Contractors, as amicus curiae, denied. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Ninth Supreme Judicial District, denied.
